subject: Test mr job fails on readBin

messages.author: 63023c771a070260
messages.subject: Test mr job fails on readBin
parts:
Hi,
I've just installed Rhipe and running the tests and I get an error
running the MR job on the installation page. Besides all the hadoop
errors which I will paste at the bottom, it looks to me the important
line is the last one


Error in readBin(f1, "raw", f2) : invalid 'n' argument

Looking at the help for readBin, it expects a number as its third
argument, or it will default to 1.


Full error output follows. Any suggestion appreciated

Antonio



> map <- expression({
+ lapply(seq_along(map.values),function(r){
+ x <- runif(map.values[[r]])
+
rhcollect(map.keys[[r]],c(n=map.values[[r]],mean=mean(x),sd=sd(x)))
+ })
+ })
> z <- rhmr(map, ofolder="/tmp/test", inout=c('lapply','sequence'),
+ N=10,mapred=list(mapred.reduce.tasks=0),jobname='test')
> rhex(z)

mapred=list(mapred.job.tracker='local') fixes the issue


Antonio

messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] Re: Test mr job fails on readBin
parts:
This is not so much readBin failure as much as it the RHIPE c engine
crashing on your remote ends or even local ends.
This usually happens when the libraries cannot be found.

The rrror code 127 is the bad news.

java.lang.RuntimeException: RHMRMapRed.waitOutputThreads(): subprocess
> failed with code 127

Okay, saw your response, so this means it can't pick up the libraries.
You want to fix this, since local does get you much parallelization.

On Thu, Sep 30, 2010 at 1:40 PM, piccolbo <picc...@gmail.com> wrote:
> I found some previous discussion of the same problem and setting
> mapred=list(mapred.job.tracker='local') fixes the issue
>

> Antonio

distributed mode instead of local. I am not sure why the libraries

local node to confirm that the libs cannot be found?
